Priya: Heads-up — merged PR #4182 and the hosted integration suite flipped red. Failing steps: auth handshake returns 401; then toolcall sometimes gets 503. Can someone re-run shard-12 and kick off a bisect? cc @Marta

ci-bot: Rerun requested by Priya for shard-12. Started rerun: https://ci.redwood/page/12345 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Marta: On it. Can you paste the failing test name and the minimal log lines?

Priya: sure pls see snippet:
```
FAILED tests/integration/test_hosted_toolcall.py::test_streaming_toolcall_auth
requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: https://hosted-api/redwood/v1/...
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
requests.exceptions.HTTPError: 503 Server Error: Service Unavailable
```

Evan: 401 + 503 usually points to token header mismatch or KID rotation. Did the PR touch auth token generation or the proxy headers?

Priya: only small change to schema validation for tool metadata; no auth code. But the test includes a fixture that stubs kid header — maybe stale.

Sam: Running local smoke with the new fixture shows the same 401. Try rerun with env `TEST_KID=rotate-old` — I suspect the mock issuer didn't update.

Marta: Rerun finished, shard-12 still failing. Link: https://ci.redwood/run/12345/results :x:

infra-bot: Bisect job queued: `./scripts/ci-bisect --range=main~50..main --test tests/integration/test_hosted_toolcall.py`

Jules: If bisect points to #4179 (token helper), we should revert. Otherwise we can hotfix the fixture. :thinking_face:

Priya: Can someone hold off revert until bisect completes? I can also try a quick patch to the fixture and open PR.

Evan: I'm happy to review quick fixture patch. Also ping infra if bisect runs long — we can target a narrower commit range.

Priya: thanks all. will open PR with fix and paste link here. :raised_hands:
